title: Cloud PKI Integration with Intune (Certificate Management Modernization)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (modernize certificate management to a cloud PKI integrated with Intune; connector/plugin, SCEP/PKCS issuance, trust chain, migration off legacy CA; higher risk to auth).
Vendor-neutral: specific cloud-PKI product internals deferred to the vendor's documentation. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Modernize certificates — issue them from a cloud PKI through Intune, and retire the on-prem CA dependency
problem: Device and user certificates are everywhere — Wi-Fi, VPN, authentication — but issuing them from an aging on-prem CA + connector chain is fragile and hard to scale. A cloud PKI with an Intune integration modernizes this: certificates are issued to Intune-managed devices through the cloud PKI's Intune connector/plugin, with the trust chain deployed and the on-prem dependency reduced or retired. This solution sets up the cloud PKI ↔ Intune integration, issues certificates via SCEP/PKCS profiles, and migrates certificate workloads off the legacy CA.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how a cloud PKI integrates with Intune (connector/plugin, SCEP/PKCS issuance), the trust-chain model, what modernizing off an on-prem CA looks like, and the migration/coexistence approach.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a cloud PKI subscription with an Intune integration, the trust chain, target device groups, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Cloud-PKI product specifics are deferred to the vendor's documentation.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect the cloud PKI to Intune, deploy the trusted root/intermediate chain, create SCEP/PKCS certificate profiles, issue to a pilot, validate certificate-backed scenarios (Wi-Fi/VPN/auth), migrate workloads off the legacy CA, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — certificate/connector readiness discovery, per-device certificate-issuance validation, a certificate coverage and expiry report, safe remediation of failed issuance, and a certificate-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Modernize certificate management with a cloud PKI integrated with Intune — issue certificates via SCEP/PKCS through the cloud PKI's Intune connector, deploy the trust chain, and migrate off the on-prem CA. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
